issues.detail: The Greek 'το εκ μερους' (the part/portion) is translated as 'điều thuộc về phần', which is a confusing construction in Vietnamese. In this context (likely referring to 1 Corinthians 15:24), it refers to the 'partial' nature or the 'part' of the body, but the Vietnamese phrasing suggests 'something belonging to a part,' which alters the clarity of the Greek subject.
